description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans client connection events, specifically testing notification patterns for connection loss and gateway count changes. It defines classes for event notification, a test cluster configurator, and two test methods verifying event dispatch when disconnected from the cluster and upon gateway reconnects.

classes.name: EventNotifier<TEventArgs>
classes.description: A generic class implementing an event notification pattern with subscribe/unsubscribe and notify functionalities using immutable lists.

classes.name: Configurator
classes.description: Implements IClientBuilderConfigurator to set up event notifiers and connect them with client events in Orleans configuration.

classes.name: ClientConnectionRegisteredServiceEventTests
classes.description: A test class containing unit tests for verifying client connection event notifications in an Orleans cluster.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test class, retrieving event notifiers from the service provider.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster builder, adding client builder configurator.

methods.name: EventSendWhenDisconnectedFromCluster
methods.description: Test verifying that a connection lost event is sent when the cluster disconnects.

methods.name: GatewayChangedEventSentOnDisconnectAndReconnect
methods.description: Test verifying that gateway count changed events are sent on disconnect and reconnect, including reestablishing gateway connections.
